column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to give assistance and aid in every respect for the
conservation  and  development  of  historical
places of Buddhist religious importance and all the
relevant ancient artifacts  declared by or under  law
made by Parliament to be of national importance;
to  implement  environmental  friendly  programmes
for and to implement training programmes to raise
awareness among the adherents of the Buddhist faith
regarding  the  need  to  protect  natural  resources
declared by or under law made by Parliament to be
of national importance;
to render assistance to economically disadvantaged
farmer families who are adherents of the Buddhist
faith in relation to the obatining of housing facilities;
to  supply  materials  needed  for  the  restoration
of  Pre-Schools  establishd  for  adherents  of  the
Buddhist  faith  which  find  it  difficult  to  function
and  to  encourage  qualified  teachers  to  engage  in
educational activities in such pre-schools;
to  establish  Vocational  Training  Centres  for  the
benefit of the unemployed youth among adherents
of the Buddhist faith;
to  develop  religious  centers  in  villages  where
people  of  low  income  groups  who  are  adherents
of the Buddhist faith are in the majority and to assist
in promoting religious education among adherents
of the Buddhist faith;
